{"file":"src/Features/Cdn/Providers/SelfHosted/SelfHostedOffloader.php","line":110,"rule":"Errors, Exceptions, and API Contracts: Throwable caught and silently discarded","severity":"medium","message":"The catch block swallows every Throwable with an empty body, so R2 failures are neither logged nor reported. It also catches programming errors such as TypeError, not only storage failures. Execution then continues to `$this->keys->clear()`, which removes the attachment's key mapping even though the R2 delete failed. The objects stay in the bucket with no record of their key, so nothing can retry the delete or find them later. Catch the specific R2 exception, log it, and keep the key mapping (or queue a retry) when the delete fails."}

The project rules say comments must explain why, and CLAUDE.md says never to add comments that justify a decision. Remove it or replace it with the reason the error is safe to drop."}
